map.根据设计流量与经济流速计算管径，并按曼宁公式计算沿程水头损失: From design diversion flow and economic velocity, calculate the recommended pipe diameter and estimate friction head loss by Manning, balancing investment and pumping energy.
map.💡 管径 D=√(4Q/πV)；沿程水头损失 hf=10.29·n²·L·Q²/: 💡 Diameter D=√(4Q/πV); friction loss hf=10.29·n²·L·Q²/D^5.33; total loss=hf×(1+minor%)
map.经济流速参考：钢管 1.5~3.0 m/s，混凝土管 1.0~2.0 m/s，塑: Economic velocity: steel 1.5–3.0 m/s, concrete 1.0–2.0 m/s, plastic 1.0–2.5 m/s

map.大管径取 1~2 m/s，权衡管材与泵送能耗综合优化。: Large diameter 1–2 m/s; trade pipe cost vs pumping energy.
